# pemdas-eval-gen

This is a template module for experimenting with the [Pretty Good Parser Generator](https://github.com/johnkerl/pgpg).

## Usage

* `./generate.sh` will turn the `.bnf` file into autogenerated lexer and parser; `main.go` will include those and run them
* `go build` to build the `tryparse` executable
* `./tryparse -e 1+2`
* `./tryparse -v -e 1+2`
